name: Rebuke
overview: Scripture teaches that rebuke is a necessary and loving act within the community of believers to address sin and promote spiritual growth. Leviticus 19:17 commands believers not to harbor hatred but to rebuke their neighbor to prevent ongoing sin, while Luke 17:3 emphasizes careful and forgiving correction when a brother trespasses. Proverbs highlights the value of accepting reproof as a sign of wisdom and love for instruction, contrasting it with the folly of rejecting correction. Galatians 6:1 calls for restoration in a spirit of meekness, reminding believers to be humble and vigilant against temptation as they rebuke others.
